sources.snippet: 🇸🇦 Saudi Arabic ASR (Zipformer Transducer) Automatic Speech Recognition for Saudi Arabic (SAU) dialect. Upload an audio file or record directly from your microphone. Model: Zipformer2 Transducer trained on GigaSpeech3 Saudi Arabic data. Supported audio: WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, etc. (automatically resampled to 16kHz)
